entries.EN:
Well, there are two well known sources of psi-emissions: the ill famed Brain Scorcher and of-course the "Yantar" plant territory.
		It's apparently the reason behind the high number of zombies emerging from the area.
		It is rumored that there's one more powerful emitter at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and it is the one that causes psi-storms. But nobody has been there, so it's up to you to decide whether to believe it or not.

entries.JA_new:
サイ放射の発生源としてよく知られているのは二つだ。悪名高いブレイン・スコーチャーと、「ヤンター」施設の一帯だ。
		あの辺りでゾンビが大量に現れるのは、そのせいらしい。
		チェルノブイリ原子力発電所には、さらに強力な放射源があって、サイストームを引き起こしているという噂もある。だが、あそこへ行った者はいない。信じるかどうかは、あんた次第だ。

entries.EN:
The main difference lies in the behavioral patterns: when undisturbed by anything, zombies keep staggering aimlessly here and there without any apparent purpose. They can be recognized from a distance by their characteristic wobbly gait and inarticulate muttering. 
They never apply any tactical maneuvering in combat, they don't use formations, they don't take cover, no bounding or suppressive fire. They head straight for the danger, intent on killing it by any means necessary and with virtually no skill.

entries.JA_new:
大きな違いは行動パターンだ。刺激されていないゾンビは、目的もなくふらふら歩き回る。遠くからでも、よろめくような足取りと意味のないうなり声ですぐ分かる。 
戦闘中に戦術的な動きは一切しない。隊形も組まないし、遮蔽物にも隠れない。連携して進んだり、援護射撃をしたりもしない。危険に向かってまっすぐ突っ込み、何としても殺そうとする。やり方はひどく稚拙だがな。

entries.EN: Zombified stalkers are, in fact, just ordinary people who suffered from the full impact of psi-emissions, sustaining irreversible damage of several regions of their brain. Their mind, behavior and reflexes will have been turned less acute, with some memories lingering behind as well. As a result of this brain damage, they will often attack without scruples and cannot be reasoned with. They lead a very simple, almost animalistic existence in small packs, not unlike wolves.

entries.EN: Most effective, of course, is putting several sharp shots in the zombie's head, because shooting at the body and extremities will accomplish nothing. You'll simply waste your ammo, as the zombie continues to function even despite terrible injuries. From what is known so far, a zombie's brain no longer relies on oxygen to function, so blood loss and oxygen deprivation ceases to be a factor. Direct destruction of the brain function is the only way, unless you prefer to waste ammo in destroying the zombie's body significantly enough to prevent further ability to move.

entries.JA_new: 一番効果的なのは、頭に正確な銃弾を何発も撃ち込むことだ。胴体や手足を撃っても意味はない。ひどい傷を負わせても動き続けるから、弾を無駄にするだけだ。今分かっている限り、ゾンビの脳は酸素がなくても機能する。だから出血や酸欠では止まらない。脳の機能を直接破壊するしかない。そうでなければ、動けなくなるまで体を撃ち壊すのに、弾を使い切ることになる。

entries.EN: It seems that they are human beings who underwent horrific mutation, much like many of the Zone's animals. It is not known what influences these mutations to occur and why it doesn't happen to every human being who spends a while in the Zone, but one thing is for sure. The mutation gives snorks extreme physical agility and reflexes, as well as a cunning animal instinct, the price is a total loss of higher human cognition. These animal instincts help them survive in Zone, prevent them from straying into danger such as anomalies or other dangerous mutants. I've heard theories that suggest any stalker caught outside during a blowout can become corrupted in this way, not sure if there is any substance to it, though.

entries.JA_new: スノークは、ゾーンの動物たちと同じように、恐ろしい変異を遂げた人間らしい。何が変異を引き起こすのか、なぜゾーンで暮らす人間が皆そうなるわけではないのかは分かっていない。確かなのは、変異によって並外れた身体能力と反射神経、狡猾な獣の本能を得る代わりに、人間らしい高度な知性を完全に失うことだ。その本能のおかげで生き延び、アノマリーや他の危険なミュータントにも近づかずに済んでいる。ブロウアウトの最中に外にいたストーカーは、誰でもこうなり得るという説も聞いた。どこまで本当かは分からないがな。

entries.EN:
They have other abilities which I didn't mention: they can regenerate from damage at an alarmingly fast rate, which is common for all of the Zone's creations. They have excellent predatory skill, they know how to cunningly stalk prey without making any noise and prefer to strike from behind, much like large cats. Also, much like cats, they have very sharp scotopic vision, this is why they thrive in pitch dark places and don't require any light.
One notable feature of their enhanced agility is their jumping, they're very well known for their tendency to pounce at their prey from a long distance, upwards of 10 meters. This is due to a mutation of the hind legs, their tendons and muscles become very durable and act like a spring under tension, which then propels them forward when the energy is released. This is why they tend to move around on all fours, their legs don't work the same as before and they are in effect no longer bipedal creatures. So, in essence, don't underestimate their speed, their ability to leap at you and of-course the blows administered with their hind legs, they have enough energy to shatter your bones.

まだ話していない能力もある。ゾーンの生き物に共通することだが、驚くほどの速さで傷が治る。狩りの腕も見事だ。音を立てずに獲物へ忍び寄り、ネコ科の大型獣のように背後から襲う。猫と同じく暗い場所でもよく見えるから、真っ暗なところでも平気で動き回るし、明かりも要らない。
特に目を引くのが跳躍力だ。10メートル以上離れた獲物にも飛びかかる。後ろ脚が変異し、腱や筋肉が頑丈なバネのようになっている。力をためてから、一気に前方へ跳ぶわけだ。脚の仕組みが変わったため、四つん這いで移動する。もう二本足で歩く生き物とは言えない。速さや飛びかかりに気をつけろ。後ろ脚の蹴りも侮れない。骨を砕くほどの力がある。

entries.EN:
They really like dark areas, preferably within strong radiation fields, and interestingly enough, around the "Brain Scorcher" in particular. These areas give snorks unique advantages when hunting big prey, such as humans. We get affected by such areas, they simply do not. 
Always be prepared to encounter snorks down inside artificial tunnels and caves, in basements and old ruins. \nTheir numbers increase towards the center of the Zone, you won't see many of them out on the peripheries, near the borders.

スノークは暗い場所を好む。特に強い放射線の中、とりわけ「ブレイン・スコーチャー」の周辺にな。そういう場所では、人間のような大きな獲物を狩るのに有利だ。俺たちは影響を受けるが、奴らは平気らしい。 
人工のトンネルや洞窟、地下室、古い廃墟で遭遇することを常に覚悟しておけ。 \nゾーンの中心に近づくほど数が増える。外縁部や境界付近では、あまり見かけない。

entries.EN:
Not by Psy-Dogs, that's for sure. Although snorks may be reduced to simple animals, they have still got traces of human-like alpha activity in their brain current, which is different from that of Chernobyl dogs. While a Psy-Dog may influence a human mind, they cannot control it. We believe it may be the same for a snork.
		Now, Controllers on the other hand... That is a difficult question to answer. There are no places in the periphery of the Zone to be inhabited by both kinds, so we have never had a chance to observe a snork influenced by a controller. 
		Closer to the center, however, the population density of mutants increases greatly and thus this possibility is more likely the closer one gets to the Chernobyl power plant. The main question is if a snork's brain has enough of the "human-like basis" left for a controller to establish a psi-connection. For now, this remains simply an open ended scientific theory.

entries.JA_new:
サイドッグに操られることはない。スノークは単純な獣に近いが、脳波には人間のようなアルファ波がわずかに残っている。チェルノブイリの犬とは違うんだ。サイドッグは人間の精神に影響を与えられても、操ることはできない。スノークも同じだと考えている。
		一方、コントローラーとなると話は別だ。答えるのは難しい。ゾーンの外縁には両方が生息する場所がないから、コントローラーの影響を受けたスノークを観察できたことがない。 
		だが中心部に近づけば、ミュータントの数は大きく増える。チェルノブイリ発電所へ近づくほど、その可能性も高まる。問題は、スノークの脳にコントローラーがサイ接続を確立できるだけの「人間らしさ」が残っているかどうかだ。今のところ、結論の出ていない仮説にすぎない。

entries.EN:
Well, there are plenty of mysteries surrounding snorks, which are as of yet unexplained. Why are they often seen wearing military gear such as gas masks, army boots and weapon holsters? Why do they have distinct injuries around the spinal column? In fact, why are they all so much alike in general?! As we have established, they don't breed - no female individuals have been identified - so how do they manage to keep their numbers up? 
When the Zone first emerged, many of the initial disaster responders died tragically, perhaps this is what became of them? And perhaps blowouts are responsible for the continuous replenishment of their numbers. And has anyone ever seen or heard of a snork dying of natural causes like old age? Found any bones? Any body fragments signifying natural decomposition? There are no answers for that yet.

entries.JA_new:
スノークには未解明の謎が多い。ガスマスクや軍用ブーツ、ホルスターといった軍用品を身につけていることが多いのはなぜか。脊柱の周りに、はっきりした傷があるのはなぜか。そもそも、どうして皆こんなにそっくりなんだ？繁殖しないことは分かっている。メスは一体も確認されていない。それなのに、どうやって数を保っているんだ？ 
ゾーンが生まれたとき、初動の災害対応に当たった人々が大勢命を落とした。彼らがスノークになったのかもしれない。ブロウアウトが数を補充し続けている可能性もある。老衰で死んだスノークを見た者はいるのか？骨や、自然に腐敗した跡は見つかっているのか？まだ答えは出ていない。

entries.EN:
Of-course. I suppose that the similarities between all snorks comes from their origin - one and the same starting template for all of them. Where this template came from is another thing. But there is no doubt that they descend from humans. 
		There must be a reason for these creatures' emergence and similarities, whether they are some types of clones or duplicates, or whether their mutation simply works by stripping away anything unique and reverting to a baseline template. Either way, exterminating them will only be possible once we identify precisely their point of origin and the means by which they replenish.

entries.EN: Hmph, you want to know if snorks mate with each other? No, there are no females in snork packs, because there are no women in the Zone. Even if a woman came to the Zone and was theoretically turned into a snork, I doubt she would be capable of reproduction. All male specimens tested and autopsied have been found to be completely sterile, and field observations have noticed a complete lack of any basic mating instinct. This makes us hope for the utter elimination of their kind by means of proper clean-up operations of their lairs, and understanding the factors behind their creation. Snorks are most certainly the result of some terrible fate befalling stalkers in the Zone, perhaps we could learn how to reverse it or prevent it from happening in the first place.

entries.EN:
The origin of chimeras is unknown. As a matter of fact, this is true for most other mutants as well... Chimeras are remarkably viable and exceptionally malicious. Once one of them has you in its sights, it will never let you go. It will continue coming for you until one of you is dead, regardless of how much danger you may pose to it. This apparent lack of a survival instinct makes the chimera extremely dangerous and unique, it won't retreat in fear like a wounded dog, normal survival behaviors such as limping away from a stronger opponent do not apply here. Also, unlike a dog, the contact pressure of the mutant's maxilla is comparable to that of an industrial press...
		 Chimeras prey on everything indiscriminately, even when not hungry. Hunting is like a sport to them, they toy with their prey like a cat and mouse, they don't scoff at eating carrion but would much rather prefer to hunt living prey for this reason. When hungry, the predator becomes even more dangerous and expands hunting range, straying into new territories. It is precisely at this stage when most stalkers report their encounters, often with deadly consequences. A hungry chimera straying into stalker territory always results in bloodshed. When desperately hungry, cannibalism is not unheard of and a chimera may even attack other representatives of its own kind for nourishment. Everything is on the food-chain, bloodsuckers, snorks, boar, flesh and of-course, humans... There's something feline in nature about these beasts, something sadistic, impetuous and deadly silent. Just like large hunting cats out in the African Savanna, it will eat its prey alive, almost always starting by devouring the soft underbelly and genitalia. In essence, it is the Bengal Tiger of the Zone.

キメラの起源は分かっていない。実のところ、他のミュータントの多くも同じだ……キメラは驚くほど生命力が強く、ひどく凶暴だ。一度狙われたら、どちらかが死ぬまで追ってくる。こちらがどれほど危険な相手でも構わずにな。生存本能が欠けているように見えるため、キメラは非常に危険で特異な存在だ。傷を負った犬のように怯えて逃げたり、強敵から足を引きずって逃げたりはしない。さらに、顎の噛む力は工業用プレスに匹敵する……
		キメラは腹が減っていなくても、手当たり次第に獲物を狩る。狩りは娯楽のようなものだ。猫がネズミをいたぶるように獲物を弄び、死肉も食べるが、生きた獲物を好む。空腹になると、さらに危険になり、縄張りを広げて新しい場所へ進出する。ストーカーが遭遇するのは、たいていこの段階だ。腹を空かせたキメラがストーカーの縄張りへ入り込めば、必ず血が流れる。ひどく飢えれば共食いも珍しくなく、同種のキメラを襲って食べることさえある。食物連鎖の頂点にいるのは、ブラッドサッカー、スノーク、ボア、フレッシュ、そしてもちろん人間だ……どこか猫科の獣を思わせる。嗜虐的で、短気で、足音を立てない。アフリカのサバンナにいる大型の狩猟猫と同じく、獲物を生きたまま食べる。まず柔らかい腹や性器に食らいつくことが多い。まさにゾーンのベンガルトラだ。

entries.EN:
A Chimera attacks by leaping at prey, often getting very close from behind in complete silence. If the initial leap connects with the victim, then most of the time the victim doesn't have a chance to even realize what happened before they are rammed into the ground by the weight of the beast. If the leap happens to miraculously miss the intended target, the predator will swiftly vanish into the scenery for a short while, leaving the prey perplexed and confused. The whole attack can be so silent that it's entirely possible the target would never even see the monster as it leaps, and pass off the disturbance in the air and shrubbery as a hallucination or just a sudden breeze... 
		The beast knows how to keep still, lay low and remain camouflaged in the environment, so chances are you won't be able to spot it if it doesn't want to be found. For this reason it prefers to hunt in fields and other areas with grass and shrubbery. On the other hand, if you're an experienced stalker with a keen eye and you know what you're looking for, there is some chance you'll spot the beast squatting in the shrubbery near you, just a split second before it leaps in your direction. Here's hoping you have a good trigger reflex if that ever happens to you.

If the leap happens to miraculously miss the intended target, the predator will swiftly vanish into the scenery for a short while, leaving the prey perplexed and confused. The whole attack can be so silent that it's entirely possible the target would never even see the monster as it leaps, and pass off the disturbance in the air and shrubbery as a hallucination or just a sudden breeze... 
		The beast knows how to keep still, lay low and remain camouflaged in the environment, so chances are you won't be able to spot it if it doesn't want to be found. For this reason it prefers to hunt in fields and other areas with grass and shrubbery. On the other hand, if you're an experienced stalker with a keen eye and you know what you're looking for, there is some chance you'll spot the beast squatting in the shrubbery near you, just a split second before it leaps in your direction. Here's hoping you have a good trigger reflex if that ever happens to you.
entries.JA_new:
キメラは獲物に跳びかかって襲う。多くの場合、音もなく背後から接近する。跳躍が命中すれば、獲物は何が起きたか理解する間もなく、その巨体に地面へ押し倒される。奇跡的に外した場合、キメラは素早く風景に紛れて姿を消し、獲物を困惑させる。攻撃はあまりに静かで、跳びかかる姿を見逃し、空気や茂みの揺れを幻覚や突風のせいだと思うことさえある…… 
		キメラは身を低くしてじっとし、周囲に溶け込むのがうまい。見つかりたくない相手を見つけるのは難しいだろう。だから草地や茂みのある場所で狩る。だが、目の利くベテランストーカーなら、すぐ近くの茂みにうずくまる姿を、こちらへ跳ぶほんの一瞬前に見つけられるかもしれない。その時に備えて、反射的に引き金を引けることを祈るよ。

entries.EN:
You see, this creature's behavior is utterly unpredictable. It can be neither understood nor rationally explained from an evolutionary point of view. I have tried researching chimeras once upon a time, tried to locate one in the wild so that field observations could be made to catalog behavioral patterns such as mating, hierarchical preferences or activity habits. It wasn't very long until I realized that nothing would come out of it. Our attempts to make contact with the monster were unsuccessful. What else could I tell you. Though it has two heads, they seem to share a singular mind... And there was a feeling that this mind is somewhere far away, detached from the body, like the body is just a tool to be recklessly cast away... 
		Every chimera seems to have its own unique qualities and habits, like they have a personality. That makes any careful observation of a solitary individual absolutely useless when the results are applied to another one. What good is advice on a Chimera's sleeping patterns to a hunter stalker, when another Chimera has a different personality and happens to, for example, enjoy a pleasant stroll at sunrise as opposed to the moonlight?? 
		Despite appearing to be a brutal, bloodthirsty beast, I suppose it very well may be in possession of some form of higher intellect, a rare trait indeed amongst the Zone's creations. Trying to communicate with it is so far completely out of the question, and I would not advise you to try and strike up a conversation with it, should you ever be unlucky enough to encounter one.

この生き物の行動は、まったく予測できない。進化の観点から理解することも、理屈で説明することもできない。昔、キメラを研究しようとしたことがある。野生の個体を探し、交尾や序列、活動時間といった行動を現地で観察して記録するつもりだった。だが、すぐに無理だと分かった。接触を試みても、うまくいかなかったんだ。ほかに何が言える？頭は二つあるが、心は一つを共有しているように見える……その心は体から離れた遠い場所にあって、体は乱暴に使い捨てられる道具にすぎない。そんな感覚があった…… 
		キメラには一体ごとに独自の性質や習性がある。まるで個性があるかのようだ。だから一体を注意深く観察しても、その結果を別の個体に当てはめることはできない。別のキメラは性格が違い、月明かりでなく朝日を浴びて散歩するのが好きかもしれない。そんな相手を狩るストーカーに、ある個体の睡眠時間を教えても役に立たないだろう？ 
		荒々しく血に飢えた獣に見えるが、もしかすると高い知性を持つのかもしれない。ゾーンの生き物の中でも、そんな例は稀だ。意思疎通を試みるのは論外だし、運悪く出くわしても話しかけようとは思わない方がいい。

entries.EN: Some Chimeras have developed a unique ability, no idea how, but it seems to work similarly to how an electric eel is capable of delivering a powerful electric shock in defense. This new variant shows no difference from an ordinary chimera in its outward appearance. This so called "electro-chimera" is capable of generating and accumulating a potent static charge of electricity, which, upon discharge, is capable of arcing and striking anything grounded within a 2 to 5 meter radius. If the soil in the area happens to be saturated with anomalous energy, the radius of this discharge may go up to 15 to 20 meters.

entries.EN:
Because the static discharge travels along the ground, the most lethal energy potential will radiate horizontally in proportion to their source, whereas any vertical distance from the ground will quickly negate the threat level posed by this electrical discharge. So, relatively safe distances from the ground are reached at around 3 to 4 meters. Naturally, these factors are greatly influenced by precipitation, especially heavy rainfall during a thunderstorm. \nFamiliarity with this feature has helped some hunters survive encounters with electrochimeras, the solution is to climb up to a great height as quickly as possible before it has the chance to offload on you. Jumping at the precise moment of the discharge may potentially work, but I wouldn't risk my life testing that theory. 
		If you're planning to hunt one of them, consider investing in some type of protective gear that works against high voltage. Also, remember, this is still a Chimera, so climbing up on top of a large container or rock is not going to mean you're safe, it can still be quite capable of leaping up at you. If you put yourself in that situation with no way out, might as well serve yourself up to it on a plate with a side of salt and pepper.

電撃は地面を伝う。だから最も強い電流は、発生源を中心に地面に沿って広がる。地面から垂直に離れれば、危険は急速に弱まる。地上から3～4メートルも離れれば、比較的安全だ。もちろん、雨、特に雷雨の激しさにも大きく左右される。 \nこの特性を知っていたおかげで、エレクトロキメラとの遭遇を生き延びたハンターもいる。放電される前に、できるだけ高い場所へ登るんだ。放電の瞬間に跳べば助かるかもしれないが、命を賭けて試す気にはならない。 
		狩るつもりなら、高電圧に耐える防具を用意しろ。それと、相手はキメラだ。大きなコンテナや岩の上に登ったから安全、というわけじゃない。跳びかかってくることもある。逃げ場のない場所に自分を追い込んだら、塩と胡椒を添えて皿に乗せたも同然だ。

entries.EN:
It is significant to note that sometimes the so called "Kolobok" artifacts are found in the gastrointestinal tracts of chimeras. I've had a few brought in by Duty and I've done a few autopsies, and this is the trend I have observed.
		I venture to give utterance to my theory that swallowing of these artifacts makes ordinary chimeras become electro-chimeras. 
\nSadly, I was not able to explicitly confirm this link between artifact consumption and the ability to generate electric fields. I do not know how these organs have come to exist, how they work, how well they perform at accumulation and discharge of electrical energy nor anything about their potency. This is all due to one simple reason, namely the fact that nobody has ever succeeded in capturing a chimera alive! All the specimens that have been delivered to us turned out to be in a very poor condition, a testament to their apparent resilience to damage and the brutal gunfight that was necessary to put them down. To put bluntly, the Duty soldiers who killed them had to unload a significant amount of firepower to put them down, and in all cases the end result was something that resembled an industrial accident at a sausage factory.

注目すべきなのは、キメラの消化管から「コロボーク」が見つかることがある点だ。デューティーが何体か運び込んできたので、解剖して傾向を調べた。
		このアーティファクトを飲み込むと、普通のキメラがエレクトロキメラになるのではないか。私はそう考えている。
\n残念ながら、アーティファクトの摂取と電場を生み出す能力の関係は、まだ確証を得られていない。こうした器官がどう生まれ、どう働くのか。電気をどれだけ蓄え、どれほど強く放電できるのかも分からない。理由はただ一つ、生きたキメラの捕獲に成功した者がいないからだ！こちらに運ばれてきた個体はどれもひどい状態だった。キメラの頑丈さと、倒すために激しい銃撃戦が必要だったことの証拠だ。率直に言えば、殺したデューティーの兵士たちは、仕留めるために大量の火力を浴びせている。どの死体も、ソーセージ工場で事故が起きたような有様だった。

entries.EN:
Although everybody in the Zone has heard about bloodsuckers, there are few men lucky enough to have survived an encounter with that monster to be able to talk about it. As for me, I have seen them only on some photos. According to witnesses, bloodsuckers are tall, stooping, humanoid creatures with many tentacles around their mouth. Apparently, these mutants prefer solitude, though sometimes they have been spotted in groups of up to 5 specimens. 
Their favorite areas of dwelling are abandoned places like catacombs, tunnels, damp basements and industrial ruins. Notorious sighting spots are in the vicinity of the Agroprom Research Institute and the tunnels beneath it, also some encounters are regularly reported in around the Dark Valley and the Wild Territory near the Duty base. Of course... there is also the infamous abandoned settlement by the Army Warehouses. Stalkers even refer to it by an aptly chosen moniker - "the Bloodsucker Village". \nBloodsuckers are most well known for their distinguished characteristic - 
the ability to become almost invisible to the naked eye. They mostly use it while hunting, as a superior form of camouflage while they try to approach their prey undetected. Once a specimen gets close enough to the victim, the mutant strikes forth with its feeler tentacles, instantly wrapping them around a vital area, the neck in particular. This attack is always followed by a forceful extraction of blood while the monster holds the prey tight with its powerful arms, preventing any attempt at fighting back. Loss of consciousness is very swift, we're talking seconds here, and these last few seconds of awareness are naturally going to be filled with agony and terror as the realization of what's happening sinks in just before the darkness creeps in. Mortality rate is absolute, there are no known survivors of this process, perhaps that's not such a bad thing. Imagine having to live with trauma like that...

ゾーンの誰もがブラッドサッカーの噂を聞いている。だが、遭遇して生き延び、その話をできる幸運な人間はごくわずかだ。私自身は写真でしか見たことがない。目撃者によれば、背が高く、前かがみで、口の周りに触手が生えた人型の生き物だ。普段は単独で行動するが、5体ほどの群れが見つかったこともある。 
住処にするのは、地下墓地やトンネル、湿った地下室、工場の廃墟といった放棄された場所だ。アフロプロム研究所とその地下トンネル、ダークバレーやデューティー基地近くの荒廃領域でも、目撃情報が絶えない。もちろん、軍事倉庫にある悪名高い廃村もそうだ。ストーカーたちは、そこを「ブラッドサッカーの村」と呼んでいる。 \nブラッドサッカーの最大の特徴は――
ほとんど肉眼で見えなくなる能力だ。狩りの際、獲物に気づかれずに近づくための強力な迷彩として使う。獲物に十分近づくと、触手を伸ばして首などの急所に巻きつける。獲物を強い腕で押さえつけ、抵抗できなくしてから、力ずくで血を吸い取る。意識を失うまで、ほんの数秒だ。その短い間、何が起きているか悟り、暗闇に落ちるまでの苦痛と恐怖を味わうことになる。助かった者はいない。むしろ、それでよかったのかもしれない。あんな経験を抱えて生きることを想像してみろ……

entries.EN:
If one were to ever run into a bloodsucker, my advice would be to first learn to differentiate
between the different behavioral states that these mutants most often exhibit. Knowing the creature's intentions will provide a huge advantage. Naturally, upon spotting a bloodsucker, the most probable behavior you will observe is a straight out aggressive attack. You will be immediately charged by the bloodsucker, which will most likely use its ability to camouflage itself and vanish from your field of view. It will then run around you with alarming speed, trying to throw you off guard and hit you from the back or flanks, spelling certain death. Aside from their feelers, they also have very powerful, clawed arms which can eviscerate you with a single swipe. For this reason, this is the most dangerous stage of the attack where mistakes are deadly, so cover all your sectors and pay attention to sounds! This will often be your one and only warning, keep in mind that this beast is heavy and you can hear its footsteps and deep breathing as it gets closer. Based on that sound, you'll be able to predict its location and maybe catch some sight of it, even if it's just a ripple in the air. You won't have much time so don't delay in firing on suspected locations. If you manage to wound it, you can temporarily render it visible as pain apparently seems to disable its ability for camouflage. 
It is also very important not to give way to panic, whatever you do, don't turn your back on it and try to flee! I assure you that a bloodsucker can easily outrun any professional athlete and give Usain Bolt a run for his money, never-mind some overloaded stalker wearing a gas mask. Put simply, if you get into this situation, your only options are to fight or die, nothing in between. \nNow, another type of common behavior you may observe during a bloodsucker encounter is known as the quiescent mode, which actually means that the mutant is as of yet completely unaware of your presence! The most reasonable action here will be to retreat quietly, paying attention to where you place your feet as you retrace your steps. You don't want to risk stepping on a dry branch or shards of glass, or worse yet, tripping over something. If you were lucky enough not to awaken the beast on approach, your reward will be the opportunity to avoid a dangerous fight, but only if you are cautious. Of course, if you are over there for the purpose of hunting these mutants, then this is also the perfect opportunity to get off a lethal shot, right for the head. Just keep in mind that although likely to be solitary, it's not uncommon to find more than one close by to each other. Always assume that there are more threats around the corner, heed on the side of caution!

ブラッドサッカーに遭遇したら、まずはよくある行動の違いを見分けることだ。
相手の意図が分かれば、大きな助けになる。姿を見つけたとき、最も多いのは、いきなり襲いかかってくるパターンだ。一直線に突進し、迷彩能力で視界から消える。それから恐ろしい速さで周囲を走り回って油断させ、背後や側面から攻撃してくる。待っているのは死だけだ。触手だけでなく、鋭い爪の生えた腕も強力で、一振りで腹を裂かれる。攻撃中は最も危険な瞬間だ。一つのミスが命取りになる。周囲を警戒し、音に注意しろ！足音や低い呼吸音が近づいてくる。重い体だからな。音を頼りに居場所を予測し、空気の揺らぎだけでも見つけられるかもしれない。時間はない。怪しい場所をためらわず撃て。傷を負わせれば、一時的に姿が見えることもある。痛みで迷彩が使えなくなるようだ。
背を向けて逃げようとするな。何があっても冷静さを失うな！ブラッドサッカーはプロの陸上選手より速い。ウサイン・ボルトでも追いつかれるだろう。ましてガスマスクを着けて荷物を背負ったストーカーじゃ話にならない。この状況になったら、戦うか死ぬか、その二つしかない。 \nもう一つよくあるのは、休眠状態だ。つまり、相手はまだこちらに気づいていない。静かに後ずさりするのが一番だ。来た道を戻りながら、足元に気をつけろ。枯れ枝やガラス片を踏んだり、何かにつまずいたりすれば、台無しだ。近づいても目を覚まさせずに済んだなら、慎重に動くことで危険な戦いを避けられる。もちろん、狩りに来ているなら、頭を狙って仕留める絶好の機会でもある。ただし、単独でいることが多いとはいえ、近くに複数いることも珍しくない。角の向こうにも敵がいると考え、用心しすぎるくらいでちょうどいい！

entries.EN:
Well, the undamaged tentacles of a bloodsucker are a very interesting object of research, 
and the relative rarity of this particular organ will guarantee to fetch a decent price. Most probably they originate from mutated mouth organs - tongue, 
cheeks and lower jaw. The tentacles contain razor sharp, hollow fangs which act like hypodermic needles - when wrapped around a human neck, these fangs will be forcefully inserted into the arteries and other blood vessels, allowing the beast to very rapidly extract and consume copious amounts of blood from the victim. The effect is similar to having your throat cut, the high blood pressure will rapidly force arterial blood out of your body, and right into the maw of the bloodsucker. This blood loss is so rapid that the brain will very quickly starve of oxygen, allowing the victim to lose consciousness within a matter of a few seconds. A very merciful fate indeed, for I found no traces of natural anesthesia in these tentacles, which is quite unusual for a blood sucking creature. Most animals which feed on blood, such as mosquitoes, leeches or ticks, they will often begin the feeding process by first injecting a substance which numbs the area before blood extraction takes place. Bloodsuckers have no such feature, they simply evolved to kill their prey outright without any concern for causing pain. They do not intend for you to survive this process, they won't just discreetly suck a bit of blood while you sleep only to slip away quietly before you wake up and swat it down, oh no... They will get their tentacles around you and bleed you dry, leaving nothing but a desiccated, mummified corpse for the other stalkers to find... cheeks and lower jaw. 傷のないブラッドサッカーの触手は、研究対象としてとても興味深い。
しかも珍しい器官だから、かなりの値がつくはずだ。おそらく、口の器官――舌や頬、
下顎が変異したものだろう。触手には、注射針のように中が空洞になった鋭い牙が並んでいる。人間の首に巻きつくと、牙が動脈などの血管に深く刺さり、獲物から大量の血を一気に吸い取る。喉を切られたのと同じだ。高い血圧で動脈の血が急速に体外へ押し出され、そのままブラッドサッカーの口へ流れ込む。出血があまりに速いため、脳がすぐ酸欠になり、数秒で意識を失う。実に慈悲深い最期だ。触手に麻酔の痕跡はなかった。吸血する生き物としては珍しい。蚊やヒル、ダニなど、多くの吸血動物は、血を吸う前に麻痺させる物質を注入する。だがブラッドサッカーには、痛みを和らげる仕組みがない。獲物を殺しきるように進化したのだ。こっそり血だけ吸って、寝ている間に立ち去るような真似はしない。触手を巻きつけ、血を一滴残らず吸い尽くす。あとに残るのは、干からびたミイラのような死体だけだ……まとめると、ブラッドサッカーの行動をよく知り、死ぬまで戦え。逃げず、複数いるものと考えろ。用心するに越したことはない。その慎重さが、ベテランストーカーと死んだストーカーを分ける。

entries.EN: There's a theory which suggests that these plagued rats are a byproduct of medical testing, it's very likely that a few specimens escaped from vivariums and began to replicate in the Zone, along with whatever disease they are carrying. The nature of the plague is very intricate in design, and leads me to guess that it is man-made in origin. This would explain why there is such a high congregation of these rats around the area of the X-18 complex. I've had a look at a few specimens, it appears as if their brain tissues have been genetically altered so as to be used as a substrate for cultivation of mutant flies. Whether the rats were exposed deliberately and then passed disease through mating, or whether they just strayed into a contaminated area, I cannot say.

entries.EN:
The flies are carriers of a pathogen which causes intense mutation of the cerebrum and thus prepares favorable conditions for larvae to breed inside of it. The flies are small enough to fit into the nasal passage of these small rodents, where they will begin the process of laying eggs in the area closest to the brain. It is during this process that the flies deposit the pathogen they carry which quickly penetrates the blood-brain barrier and begins immediately to attack the cellular structure of the brain in order to cause changes to DNA. The subsequent mutation of DNA strands causes irreversible changes to the brain, altering bio-chemistry and triggering releases of neurotransmitters which in turn lead to the brain's Ph becoming acidic in nature. In this state, the brain becomes most favorable for the larvae, however this also invariably results in physical damage to the brain and a state of partial-death, whereby higher brain functions are disabled. 
 
By the time the eggs hatch and the larvae begin burrowing into the cranial cavity, the brain is fully primed for consumption and gestation while the victim remains in a nearly comatose state, focusing only on basic survival functions like eating and sleeping. The larvae will then slowly eat portions of the brain, then turn into pupa and hatch into full grown flies. The flies will locate the holes in the skull made by the larvae upon entry and evacuate through the nose. Subject's survival depends on how much time it takes for the larvae to mature into pupa, quick transformations mean less consumption of brain matter, and thus higher chances of surviving. I don't have enough data at the moment to find out what influences that time period, but one thing is for sure. Even if you survive the process, your brain is damaged for good and you're no better than a vegetable. This is the way in which the creators of the disease likely intended for it to progress, essentially a brand new form of malaria which is propagated by a fast spreading insect and leads to certain death. 
 
This is actually my main fear, if this was indeed created in a lab, then it was likely done so with the precise intention of being a bio-weapon, especially if you consider the nature of these clandestine facilities around the Zone. A perfect place where no one can interfere with research, no matter how unethical. From what I've come to realize, these flies can indeed gestate on the human brain as well. Fortunately, for some reason, that pathogen has a limited effect on the human brain and can for the most part be swiftly defeated by the immune system, although some degree of cognitive damage is still possible. I believe the science team behind the pathogen were likely close to finding a solution, all it would take is to change the DNA of the pathogen in order to work better with human genetic code, as opposed to that of a rodent. I  wouldn't be surprised if they also had human test subjects to work on. I'd imagine they would start with trying to alter brain chemistry in another way to prime the organ for gestation, or perhaps they'd use immuno-suppressants first to allow the pathogen a fair chance at damaging the brain. Dreadful for the victims, either way. 
 
Interestingly enough, the flies have appeared to take a particular interest in zombies, I believe that the damage done to zombie brains or immune systems during their creation has allowed the pathogen to attack the cerebrum and enabled larvae to successfully gestate within the cranium, effectively causing the zombies to become the only successful "human" breeding grounds for the flies. For this reason, I'd like to remind you to avoid getting up close to any zombies, unless you want to attract any of these contaminated flies. Probably won't kill you, but it may have an effect on your cognition. If you think you've been exposed, I'd say take antibiotics as soon as humanly possible.

entries.JA_new:
ハエは脳に激しい変異を引き起こす病原体を運び、幼虫が脳内で育つのに適した環境を作る。小さなネズミの鼻腔に入り込めるほど小さいハエは、脳に近い場所へ卵を産みつける。そのとき、運んできた病原体を体内へ残す。病原体は血液脳関門をすぐに通り抜け、DNAを変化させるために脳細胞を攻撃し始める。DNA鎖が変異すると脳に回復不能な変化が起き、生化学的な働きが変わる。神経伝達物質が放出され、脳内が酸性化する。そうなると幼虫にとって最適な環境になるが、脳は損傷し、一部の機能が失われた半死状態になる。
 
卵が孵化して幼虫が頭蓋内へ潜り込む頃には、脳は食料にも成長場所にも適した状態になっている。宿主はほとんど昏睡状態になり、食べることや眠ることといった基本的な生存機能だけに反応する。幼虫は脳の一部を少しずつ食べ、蛹になったあと成虫のハエへと育つ。ハエは幼虫が頭蓋骨に開けた穴を見つけ、鼻から外へ出ていく。宿主が生き残れるかは、幼虫が蛹になるまでにかかる時間次第だ。成長が早ければ脳を食べられる量が減り、生存率も上がる。何が成長速度を左右するのか、今のところ十分なデータがない。だが、助かっても脳は元に戻らず、植物状態と変わらない。病気を作った側は、こう進行するよう意図したのだろう。急速に広がる虫が媒介し、確実に死に至らせる新種のマラリアだ。
 
これが私の最大の懸念だ。研究所で作られたものなら、生物兵器として使うつもりだったのかもしれない。ゾーンの秘密施設なら、どれほど非倫理的な研究でも邪魔されずに済む。ハエは人間の脳でも成長するようだ。幸い、病原体が人間の脳に与える影響は限られていて、免疫系がすぐに抑え込むことが多い。それでも、認知機能に損傷が残る可能性はある。病原体を研究した科学者たちは、解決策を見つける寸前だったのかもしれない。ネズミの遺伝子より人間の遺伝子に適合するよう、病原体のDNAを変えるだけでよかった。人間を実験台にしていたとしても驚かない。まず脳内の化学反応を変えて幼虫の成長に適した状態を作るか、免疫抑制剤を使って病原体が脳を傷つけやすくしようとしただろう。どちらにせよ、犠牲者には恐ろしい話だ。
 
興味深いことに、ハエはゾンビにも特に引き寄せられるようだ。ゾンビ化の過程で脳や免疫系が損傷し、病原体が脳を攻撃して幼虫が頭蓋内で育てるようになったのだろう。結果として、ハエにとって繁殖に成功する唯一の「人間」がゾンビになった。だからゾンビには近づかない方がいい。汚染されたハエを寄せつけることになる。命を落とすことはないだろうが、認知機能に影響が出るかもしれない。感染したと思ったら、できるだけ早く抗生物質を飲むことだ。

entries.EN:
Ok, listen. Regarding the Zone, it is appropriate to say that periods of relative stability are followed by short phases of instability - Blowouts. 
Phases of instability are notable for having an effect on the positioning of anomalies, emergence of fresh artifacts and the behavioral activities of mutants. 
Sometimes these phases are followed by changes in the distribution of psionic fields, resulting in localized emissions - the so called "Psi-Surges", also known as "Horror Time". 
During these psi-surges a number of unstable short-living phantasms and floating anomalies may be observed. Psi-surges cause exposed stalkers to suffer from vertigo, severe headaches and hallucinations. 
Most of the symptoms caused by these psi-storms disappear without trace as soon as the Psi-Surge is over.

いいか、聞いてくれ。ゾーンでは、比較的安定した時期のあとに、短い不安定期――ブロウアウトが訪れる。
不安定期には、アノマリーの位置が変わり、新しいアーティファクトが現れ、ミュータントの行動も変化する。
その後、サイフィールドの分布が変わり、局地的な放射が起こることがある。いわゆる「サイ・サージ」、別名「ホラータイム」だ。
サイ・サージの間は、不安定で短命な幻影や浮遊アノマリーが現れることがある。さらされたストーカーは、めまいや激しい頭痛、幻覚に襲われる。
サイ・サージが終われば、サイストームによる症状の大半は跡形もなく消える。

entries.EN:
That's right. The floating anomalies are formed when the old anomalies are replaced with new ones. This means that the floating anomalies are likely the manifestation of an intermediate phase between two stable allocations of ordinary anomalies. 
That is why the floating anomalies are temporary in nature and mostly disappear by the end of Psi-Surges.

その通りだ。浮遊アノマリーは、古いアノマリーが新しいものに置き換わるときにできる。通常のアノマリーの配置が安定するまでの、中間段階が目に見える形で現れたものだろう。
だから一時的な存在で、サイ・サージが終わる頃にはほとんど消えてしまう。

entries.EN:
Phantoms are a result of the psi-fields' interference with the human consciousness and perception. It has been determined that the quantity, form and type of phantoms depend entirely on the psychic state of the individual experiencing this phenomenon.  
For this reason, every individual will see something different. Some may see many apparitions and figments of an altered perception, some may see merely one or two. Obviously, such phantoms are non-material, merely manifestations of the effect which psi-fields have on the human brain.

幻影は、サイフィールドが人間の意識や知覚に干渉した結果だ。現象を体験する人の精神状態によって、幻影の数や姿、種類が決まると分かっている。  
そのため、見えるものは人によって違う。知覚が変わり、たくさんの幽霊や幻を見る人もいれば、一つか二つだけの人もいる。言うまでもなく、幻影に実体はない。サイフィールドが脳に与える影響が形になって見えているだけだ。

entries.EN:
The Zone can be more addictive than any drug! Stay on the outskirts for a week and you'll see for yourself. Something starts gnawing you, encouraging you to walk deeper, closer to the center and ironically closer to your death... 
Every stalker feels this pull, this motivation to go further and further into the Zone, where the danger increases exponentially. 
This is truly the primary motivation behind stalkers penetrating deeper into the Zone, for no rational mind would enter such hell with no guarantee of reward and pitiful pay. Stalkers make excuses, try to rationalize their decision to themselves and to others, that they have no other choice, that they're in it for the money and the goodies. That it is mostly due to profit that people come deeper into the Zone, where the likelihood of finding a decent artifact increases in proportion with the danger. Back in the day, when it all started and the Zone came to be, artifacts used to bring enormous profits. It wasn't easy money at all, but... It was certainly worth the effort. Back then, I would have believed their explanations. Now, I am not so sure, a common artifact can hardly afford you a decent meal at times. How is that adequate motivation to push into this misery?
People change here, they turn from rookie prospectors into real stalkers. Some of them eventually give up the charade and stop thinking about profit entirely, they begin to fully embrace the Zone and all its dangers and mysteries. Ironically, this is the point at which they become experts, and this is when the Zone rewards them with bounties.

entries.JA_new:
ゾーンは、どんな薬物よりも人を依存させる！一週間でも外縁部で過ごせば分かる。何かが心をむしばみ、もっと奥へ、中心へ行けと駆り立てる。皮肉なことに、死へ近づくとも知らずにな…… 
どのストーカーも、この引力を感じている。危険が急激に増していくゾーンの奥へ、さらに奥へ進みたくなるんだ。 
それこそが、ストーカーがゾーンの深部へ入っていく本当の理由だ。見返りの保証もなく、報酬もわずかな地獄へ、まともな人間なら入らない。ストーカーは自分や他人に言い訳をする。「ほかに選択肢がない」「金やお宝のためだ」とな。危険に見合うアーティファクトが見つかるから、利益を求めて奥へ進むんだ、と。ゾーンができたばかりの頃は、アーティファクトで大金を稼げた。楽に儲かるわけじゃなかったが……苦労に見合う価値はあった。当時なら、その説明を信じたかもしれない。だが今は違う。普通のアーティファクトじゃ、まともな食事代にもならないことがある。それで、こんな地獄へ進む動機として十分なのか？ 
人はここで変わる。駆け出しの探索者から、本物のストーカーになっていく。やがて建前を捨て、儲けのことを考えなくなる者もいる。ゾーンと、その危険や謎を受け入れるんだ。皮肉なことに、そうなって初めて一人前になり、ゾーンから報酬を得られる。

entries.EN: The artifact trade is still marginally profitable, if executed correctly you can stand to make a neat profit on even common artifacts, you just have to be prudent with your spending... Splurging money on protective gear, medication, nutritious meals and ample water supplies, all of these can deplete your profits in a blink. Sure, they'll enable you to live longer, but you'll then have to delve into more anomalies, then once you sell the artifacts you'll need to get patched up, and have your gear fixed so that you can live another day and dive into even more anomalies. The end result is a vicious circle, you're not making money, you're just running into danger for nothing as all the money you stand to make has to be spent to get you fixed up. The trick here is to fetch the artifacts and not have to spend a single dime doing it. Stalkers who figure that system out stand to get pretty rich eventually. Problem is, the most profitable artifacts are located in amongst the most dangerous anomalies, acidic, thermal, can't go into that without a protective suit, but if you go in with a protective suit, that will get damaged and you'll need it fixed, this is expensive. See the paradox here?

entries.JA_new: やり方さえ間違えなければ、アーティファクトの売買でも多少は稼げる。普通の品でも、出費に気をつければ利益は出る……防具や薬、栄養のある食事、十分な水に金を使えば、稼ぎはすぐ消える。確かに長生きはできるが、もっとアノマリーへ潜る必要がある。アーティファクトを売ったあとは治療を受け、装備を修理し、また潜る。結局、悪循環だ。稼いでいるんじゃない。修理代を払うために危険へ飛び込み、利益を全部使っているだけだ。コツは一銭も使わずアーティファクトを持ち帰ること。それを身につけたストーカーは、いずれ大金を手にする。問題は、一番儲かる品が最も危険なアノマリーの中にあることだ。酸性や熱のアノマリーには防護服なしで入れない。だが防護服を着て入れば傷み、修理が必要になる。これが高くつく。矛盾してるだろ？

entries.EN:
At the beginning, the scientists kept bombarding stalkers with orders in exchange for exorbitant rewards, private collectors bribed the military and kept hanging about near the borders, buying everything the stalkers brought to them. 
It got much more difficult for us now. Of course, the artifacts keep appearing after every blowout, but many of them are no longer worth the risk you have to face to get them. 
The scientists and collectors have got plenty of them by now, so the laws of supply and demand had their effect. Common artifacts such as "Wrenched", "Jellyfish" and the like can barely be sold for any value at this point, so many experienced stalkers don't even bother picking them up. Small wonder, those little cheap bastards will give off harmful radiation and then you're stuck holding the bill for anti-rad meds or vodka.
They're a real joy for rookies, though! Better for them to enjoy those low-cost artifacts on the peripheries, keeps them away from raiding deeper into the center of the Zone before they pick up sufficient experience. A rookie deep in the Zone is a dead man. Proved by the Zone itself.

最初の頃、科学者たちは法外な報酬と引き換えに、ストーカーへ次々と依頼を出していた。民間の収集家は軍に賄賂を渡し、国境近くに居座って、ストーカーが持ち帰る品を何でも買い取っていた。
今じゃ、こっちもずっと苦しくなった。ブロウアウトのたびにアーティファクトは現れるが、取りに行く危険に見合わない品が増えた。
科学者や収集家は、もう十分に持っている。需要と供給の法則が働いたんだ。「レンチド」や「ジェリーフィッシュ」みたいなありふれた品は、ほとんど値がつかない。経験を積んだストーカーの多くは、拾おうともしない。安物のくせに有害な放射線を出しやがる。結局、放射線対策の薬やウォッカ代を払うはめになる。
だが新人にはありがたい品だ！外縁部で安いアーティファクトを見つけて経験を積めば、ゾーンの中心へ無謀に進むのを防げる。駆け出しが深部へ入れば死ぬ。ゾーンがそれを証明している。

entries.EN:
Of course I do. "Kolobok", "Battery" and other middlings are still worth quite a lot, so nobody has any scruples about picking them up. And it would be very good luck indeed to find a "Soul"! The scientists are still begging for this rare artifact, but few stalkers were lucky enough to find even a single one of these illusive artifacts... 
Some have been found, sure, but they are almost never sold off for any price! Only a complete fool would agree to sell the only one he had - it's advantages and effects on the human body are really remarkable. I think the only other artifact with similar properties is the "Red Star", and that's a transmute. In case you don't know, transmutes are very expensive artificial artifacts that one may order at professor Sakharov's laboratory at Yantar. But one has to get there first...

もちろんだ。「コロボーク」や「バッテリー」みたいな中堅どころは、今でもかなりの値がつく。見つけたら誰だって拾うさ。「ソウル」が見つかれば、相当な幸運だ！科学者たちは今もこの希少なアーティファクトを欲しがっているが、一つでも見つけたストーカーはほとんどいない…… 
見つかったことはある。だが、どんな値をつけても手放そうとしない。持っている唯一の一つを売るのは大馬鹿だけだ。人間の体に与える効果は本当にすごいからな。同じような性質を持つのは「レッドスター」くらいだが、あれはトランスミュートだ。知らないかもしれないが、トランスミュートは人工のアーティファクトで、サハロフ教授のヤンター研究所に注文するものだ。かなり高くつくし、そもそも、そこまでたどり着かなきゃならないがな……
